description: Construction of a single storey studio building in the rear garden
subdivision_of_building: ground floor flat and the private garden only
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Following the removal of the tree as permitted by this decision, the tree shall be replaced by a species native to the UK or one known to provide benefits to wildlife. The replacement tree shall be planted during the planting season at the time of felling (end - end March) or during the next immediately available planting season. The size of the tree shall be at least a Selected Standard as per BS 3936-1:1992 (or any standard that reproduces or replaces this standard). The tree shall be maintained for 5 years after planting and should it be removed, die, be severely damaged or become seriously diseased within this period it shall be replaced with another tree as originally required to be planted by this condition.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d94b6111-7fff-fafd-647d-75ec38e18712"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: In the interests of visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The works hereby approved shall not be carried out unless in accordance with a Tree Protection Plan and Arboricultural Method Statement which has first been approved by the LPA. The measures set out in the Tree Protection Plan shall remain in place until the completion of the construction.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">REASON: To safeguard existing tree(s) in the interests of visual amenity, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-ef3b64e1-7fff-3022-5570-d50f9da13cd4"><br></span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the commencement of works, detailed drawings and full specifications of the proposed green/biodiverse roof shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The submission shall include cross-sectional drawings (scale 1:20) confirming a minimum substrate depth of 80mm, excluding the vegetative mat; drainage system; a planting plan incorporating a diverse mix of species, including native species beneficial to local wildlife; and a management and maintenance plan to ensure the long-term success of the green roof. The approved details shall be fully implemented and retained thereafter.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-565b5910-7fff-87ff-5f9f-8fc92b7c9401"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:#ffffff;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: Reason: To promote biodiversity on site through green roofs, in line with Hackney's Local Plan LP33, policy LP46 and LP47.</span></p>
